text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Zimbabwe/Malaysia joint venture company, ZIMMAL Holdings will begin construction of houses under a Z$5 billion countrywide scheme soon, according the company's Executive Director Dr Themba Sibanda. Dr Sibanda said construction will begin shortly after brickmoulding machinery imported from Australia was cleared by the department of customs and excise. Construction will begin in Bulawayo before expanding to Masvingo, Kwekwe and Plumtree and other cities.

- The Lord Mayor of London, Sir John Chalstrey, arrived in Harare last night for a two-day stay. He is expected to meet President Robert Mugabe, Finance Minister Dr Hebert Murerwa, Local Government, Rural and Urban Development Minister, John Nkomo, Health and Child Minister Dr Timothy Stamps and hold discussions with civic leaders including Harare Executive Mayor Charles Tawengwa.
